INSERT INTO mrp_daily_plan_detail (run_id, batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, path_group_key, source_month, source_date, schedule_date, system_quantity, is_production_day, revision, row_key) VALUES
(#{item.runId}, #{item.batchId}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.rootMaterialCode}, #{item.terminalMaterialCode}, #{item.terminalType}, #{item.supplyMode}, #{item.pathGroupKey}, #{item.sourceMonth}, #{item.sourceDate}, #{item.scheduleDate}, #{item.systemQuantity}, #{item.isProductionDay}, #{item.revision}, #{item.rowKey})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, schedule_date

SELECT factory_code,root_material_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode,source_month, SUM(effective_quantity) effective_quantity FROM ( SELECT d.factory_code,d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code,d.terminal_type,d.supply_mode, d.source_month,COALESCE(o.manual_quantity,d.system_quantity) effective_quantity FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail d LEFT JOIN mrp_daily_plan_override o ON o.batch_id=#{batchId} AND o.factory_code=d.factory_code AND o.root_material_code=d.root_material_code AND o.terminal_material_code=d.terminal_material_code AND o.terminal_type=d.terminal_type AND o.supply_mode=d.supply_mode AND o.path_group_key=d.path_group_key AND o.schedule_date=d.schedule_date WHERE d.run_id=#{runId} UNION ALL SELECT d.factory_code,d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code,d.terminal_type,d.supply_mode, d.source_month,o.manual_quantity FROM mrp_daily_plan_override o JOIN mrp_daily_plan_detail d ON d.run_id=#{runId} AND d.factory_code=o.factory_code AND d.root_material_code=o.root_material_code AND d.terminal_material_code=o.terminal_material_code AND d.terminal_type=o.terminal_type AND d.supply_mode=o.supply_mode AND d.path_group_key=o.path_group_key WHERE o.batch_id=#{batchId} AND d.id=(SELECT MIN(t.id) FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail t WHERE t.run_id=d.run_id AND t.factory_code=d.factory_code AND t.root_material_code=d.root_material_code AND t.terminal_material_code=d.terminal_material_code AND t.terminal_type=d.terminal_type AND t.supply_mode=d.supply_mode AND t.path_group_key=d.path_group_key) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail t WHERE t.run_id=d.run_id AND t.factory_code=d.factory_code AND t.root_material_code=d.root_material_code AND t.terminal_material_code=d.terminal_material_code AND t.terminal_type=d.terminal_type AND t.supply_mode=d.supply_mode AND t.path_group_key=d.path_group_key AND t.schedule_date=o.schedule_date) ) effective GROUP BY factory_code,root_material_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode,source_month
